about_the_game:
"Gunblade Ranger" is a post-apocalyptic roguelike top-down shooter. When nuclear fallout reduced civilization to ashes, survivors either rot in mutation or rise as purifiers. As a ranger, wield an energy-charged blade in your left hand and switch between 30+ firearms—from SMGs to radiation-pulse crossbows—in your right. Hunt mutants in procedurally generated wastelands, harvest mutagens to unlock mutant abilities, and crush grotesque horrors fused from industrial waste and human flesh. Storm the heart of the radiation source, where your final blade strike will decide humanity’s fate.

Slash Squad — 8 warriors, unique weapons/skills, gear/mutation combos for custom builds.

Wasteland Arsenal — 30+ guns, 20+tactical, 50+mutations; fresh combat every run.

Radiation Zones — 7 zones, hidden stages, rogram generated random map.

Can you survive the radiation tide, end the Storm, and reclaim humanity's future？

content_descriptors.notes:
1.During gameplay, characters will encounter cartoonish depictions of blood splatter, dismemberment, and stylized skeletal remains when defeating enemies.
2.The game contains violent use of firearms, weapons (including prop-based armaments), and explosive devices.
